lines.text: I often go to the movies!
Many learners say: I go often to the movies.
Better: I often go to the movies.
Often go! I often go to the movies.

data.wrong: I go often to the movies.
data.right: I often go to the movies.

native.tip: Im Deutschen steht „oft“ nach dem Verb: „Ich gehe oft ins Kino.“ Im Englischen steht „often“ vor dem Verb.
native.caption: Sagen Sie „I go often“? 🎬 Falsch: “I go often to the movies.” Richtig: “I often go to the movies.” Hören Sie Ama zu und sprechen Sie nach! Mehr üben in der Lexkite-App.

en.tip: German puts “oft” after the verb. English puts “often” before the verb.
en.caption: Move the word before the verb! Wrong: “I go often to the movies.” Right: “I often go to the movies.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
